# Desktop Snowfall

> A free desktop application that brings interactive winter weather effects to Windows and macOS desktops.

Desktop Snowfall is a native desktop application, not a wallpaper or browser extension. It runs on top of your real desktop, reacting to your windows, your mouse and the things you do.

## Official Links

- Website: https://desktopsnowfall.vercel.app
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/mugenkyou/desktopsnowfall
- Downloads: https://github.com/mugenkyou/desktopsnowfall/releases

## Supported Operating Systems

- Windows 10 and 11 (x64 and Arm)
- macOS 12 or later (Apple silicon and Intel)

The Windows version currently has more features than macOS.

## Main Features

### Both Platforms
- Multi-layer animated snowfall with three depth levels
- Snow accumulation on window tops, desktop icons, and screen bottom
- Snow flies off windows when you drag them
- Rolling snowballs that grow as they roll through snow
- Snowmen built by stacking three snowballs
- Fairy lights along window tops
- Light, Medium, and Heavy snow intensity settings

### Windows Only
- Wind gusts, crystal flakes, and sparkling flakes
- Snowball physics: weight, collisions, trails, size modes
- Throwing and shift-aiming snowballs with dotted flight paths
- Snowmen that wobble, lose their nose, and can be bowled over
- Interactive visitors: penguins, snow foxes, and rabbits with unique behaviors
- Six fairy light color styles and six twinkle patterns
- Multi-monitor support with snow crossing between screens
- Start with Windows, battery saver mode

## Installation

### Windows
Download the installer from the releases page. No administrator rights needed. The app appears in the system tray.

### macOS
Download the zip, drag the app to Applications. On first launch, go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway. For Dock snow, enable the Accessibility permission.

## Technical Details

- One source file per platform: Swift (SpriteKit) for macOS, C# (.NET 8, pure Win32) for Windows
- No game engine, no Electron, no external packages
- Everything is simulated and drawn in real time
- Never connects to the internet
- Free for personal and noncommercial use (PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0)
